anchor.quote: a plurality of said predefined time intervals

findings.reason: In a plurality of said predefined time intervals, said grammatically refers back to the earlier predefined time intervals. It is not a lexical modifier of time intervals. Retaining said in the normalized noun-phrase head conflicts with the head-without-determiner convention, even though the plurality-of tag already accounts for the enclosing opening.
findings.correction: Normalize the head to predefined time intervals while preserving the complete exact anchor, plurality-of tag, functional parts and source-supported earlier-interval reference. If the nested determiner construction instead requires separate nonoverlapping terms under the protocol, adjudicate that source-specific representation explicitly; do not treat said as part of the lexical name.
